content: Seosopat Wiahla Nanmwarki
Seosopat wiahla nanmwarki wiliandi seme Asa oh e kakehlahda eh manaman pwehn uhwong Israel.
E ketikihdi sounpei kei nan kelen mahwen en kahnimw kan en Suda, wasa teikan nan Suda, oh nan kahnimw kan me Asa kalowehdi nan sapwen Epraim.
KAUN-O ketin kupwuramwahwihala Seosopat pwehki eh idawehn karasepe mwahu kan en seme ni eh pwulopwul oh sohte kin kaudokiong Paal.
E kin papah Koht en seme, kapwaiada sapwellimen Koht kosonned, oh sohte kin wia soahng kan me nanmwarki kan en Israel kin wia.
KAUN-O ketin katengehdi en Seosopat manaman pohn wehin Suda, oh aramas koaros kin patohwandohng kisakis reh, kahrehda eh kepwehpwehla oh waunla mehlel.
E ketin pohnmwahsohki sapwellime doadoahk en papah KAUN-O oh kamwomwala wasahn kaudok en me rotorot akan koaros oh kilel en koht lih Asera nan Suda.
Ni sounpar kesiluhn eh mwehi, e ahpw kadarala lapalap pwukat pwe re en padahk nan kahnimw kan en Suda: Penail, Opadaia, Sekaraia, Nedanel, oh Maikaia.

Mehn Lipai duwemen oh samworo riemen me iang irail. Mehn Lipai ko iei Semaia, Nedanaia, Sepadaia, Asahel, Semiramod, Sehonadan, Adonaisa, Topaisa, oh Topadonaisa; oh samworo ko iei Elisama oh Sehoram.
Re patohwanda pwuken Kosonned en KAUN-O oh patoseli nan kahnimw koaros en Suda, padapadahkihong aramas akan audepen pwuhko.
En Seosopat eh Roson Lapalap
KAUN-O ketin kupwurehda pwe wehi kan me kapilpene Suda re en masak mahweniong Seosopat.
Mehn Pilisdia kei patohwandohng Seosopat uwen mwohni silper laud ehu oh kisakis kei oh mehn Arepia kei patohwandohng sihpw 7,700 oh kuht 7,700.
En Seosopat manaman ahpw wie kekehlailla ahnsou koaros. E kauwada kahnimw kei oh kelen mahwen kei wasa koaros nan Suda,
wasa me kiden dipwisou kin nekinekla ie. E ketikihdiong lapalap koahiek kei nan Serusalem,
nin duwen ar peneinei kan. Adna me kaunen sounpei kan sang peneineien Suda, oh e naineki sounpei 300,000.
Me keriaun kaun iei Sehohanan, me kaunda sounpei 280,000,
oh me kesiluhn kaunen iei Amasaia nein Sikri, me kaunda sounpei 200,000. (Amasaia sang ni pein nsene e wiahla sounpapah men en KAUN-O.)
Eliada me kaunen sounpei kan sang peneineien Pensamin, sounpei koahiek men ih, me kaunda sounpei 200,000, me tehtehki mehn sansar oh kesik ketieu.
Me keriaun kaun iei Sehosapad, me kaunda sounpei 180,000, me ahneki dipwisoun mahwen kaselel.
Sounpei pwukat kin doadoahkohng nanmwarkio nan Serusalem, e pil ketikihdiong ekei sounpei nan kelen mahwen teikan en kahnimw kan en Suda.
